lead.zh-Hans: 车铃响过以后，邮包碰巧答了一声。
lead.en: My mailbag happened to answer the bicycle bell.

text.zh-Hans: 沿着滨水大道走，一位骑车人从旁边经过，轻按车铃向我示意。我慢慢让到一边，邮包搭扣恰好也响了，他回头笑着挥手。我想回个同样清楚的问候，手指碰了碰搭扣，它却不肯再响。等他停下来喝水，我赶上去说明，他让我慢慢试，自己的手还搭在车铃上。
text.en: A cyclist gave a light ring as he passed me on the Rambla. I stepped aside and my mailbag buckle happened to click. He looked back, smiling and waving. I tried to answer deliberately, but the buckle went quiet. When he stopped for water, I caught up and explained. He waited while I tried again, with his own hand resting on the bell.
Try answering with two buckle clicks
See where the buckle makes its click

lead.zh-Hans: 我换了个方向，等废纸自己过来。
lead.en: I changed position and let the scrap come to me.

text.zh-Hans: 植物园外，一张废纸贴着地面翻了个跟头。我弯腰去捡，它又从指尖旁边溜开。我没有跟着扑，先把邮包放稳，绕到纸片前头蹲下来等。纸终于碰到鞋边，我捡起来收进装废物的小袋，再把袋口扎好。起身时才发觉自己还蹲着迈了一步，像要把脚下的路也折起来。
text.en: Outside the botanical garden, a scrap of litter turned over and slipped past my fingers. Instead of lunging after it, I put my bag down and crouched a little farther along its path. It reached my shoe, and I tucked it into my rubbish pouch and tied the top. Getting up, I accidentally took a crouching step, as if the path needed folding too.
Describe my very low last step
Check the knot on the rubbish pouch

lead.zh-Hans: 打招呼的手，暂时都被午饭占了。
lead.en: Our hands were fully booked at lunchtime.

text.zh-Hans: 奇维托刚端来，我还惦记着饭后的炸面饼。一位旅伴伸手想和我打招呼，我却两手捧着牛肉三明治，忙得只能点头。他索性也点了点头，端起自己的杯子。等我咽完放下三明治，他又正喝着水。我们各自等了一会儿，终于腾出手，郑重地补上了一个比午饭还慢的握手。
text.en: When my chivito arrived, I was already thinking about a torta frita afterwards. A companion offered a greeting, but both my hands were occupied with the sandwich. He nodded back and lifted his cup. By the time I had swallowed and put lunch down, he was drinking. We waited through one more turn and finally managed a handshake considerably slower than either meal.
Finish our delayed handshake
See whose hand is finally free

lead.zh-Hans: 饼边响了一声，旁边的眉毛动了。
lead.en: A crisp bite made a nearby eyebrow twitch.

text.zh-Hans: 我吃完奇维托，拿起一块炸面饼，轻轻掰下一点边。脆脆的一声，让旁边正在打盹的旅伴睁开眼睛。我停住，他又闭上眼，我再咬一口，他的眉毛却动了动。我把剩下的饼放低，等咽完才问是不是吵醒了他。他摇头笑起来，原来一直醒着，只想猜我什么时候会开口。
text.en: After my chivito, I broke a small crisp edge from a torta frita. My apparently sleeping companion opened his eyes at the crack. I paused; he closed them again. Another bite made his eyebrows twitch. After swallowing, I asked whether I had woken him. He laughed and shook his head. He had been awake, waiting to see when I would say something.
Ask whether my companion was asleep
Watch for another eyebrow twitch

lead.zh-Hans: 留半张饼的计划，被我咬出了两边。
lead.en: My plan for half a pastry acquired two bite marks.

text.zh-Hans: 午饭的奇维托吃得很饱，炸面饼便想留一半带走。我只给要吃的那半边加糖，谁知转着找位置下口时，没加糖的半边先到了嘴边。我咬完才发现，便把另一半重新转回来，认真补尝了一口。收起剩下的饼，袋子左右各鼓一点，原先打算整齐留下的半圆已经不见了。
text.en: The chivito made a substantial lunch, so I planned to save half my torta frita. I sugared the half I meant to eat, turned it to find a good starting point, and bit the unsugared side instead. I turned it back for a careful second taste. What went into the bag bulged on both sides. The tidy semicircle I had planned to save was nowhere to be seen.
Tell which bite reached the sugar
Look at the shape left in the bag

lead.zh-Hans: 名字还没念完，我的下巴先点了头。
lead.en: My nod arrived before the name was finished.

text.zh-Hans: 我在植物园外听见两位旅人讨论植物标本的名字，一人念一段，另一人接着念，谁都不敢说已经念完。我也凑过去听，却把他们中间的停顿当成了结束，提前点了头。三个人顿了一下，一起笑了。等他们重新慢慢读好，我这次把下巴收住，直到最后一个音落下才跟着点头。
text.en: Outside the botanical garden, two visitors were sounding out a plant name they had seen in its herbarium material. One read a part, the other continued, and neither seemed sure where it ended. I mistook their pause for the finish and nodded too early. We all laughed. They began again, slowly. I kept my chin firmly still until the last syllable arrived.
Ask them to finish the name slowly
Wait for the final syllable to nod

lead.zh-Hans: 你说“{reply}”，我先把发声的位置找准了。
lead.en: You wrote, “{reply}.” I found the right spot first.

text.zh-Hans: 我照你的意思，先找到了搭扣能碰响的地方，再向骑车的旅人连着敲了两下。他听明白，轻轻用车铃回了一声，我高兴得差点敲起第三下，赶快收住手。他喝好水推车走了，我沿滨水大道慢慢往前走。包带已经理顺，搭扣贴着布面，接下来一路只剩鞋底和地面轻轻相碰。
text.en: I found the spot where my buckle clicked and tapped it twice for the cyclist. He answered with one gentle ring. I nearly added a third tap in excitement, then caught my hand. He finished his water and wheeled his bicycle away while I continued along the Rambla. With the strap straightened, the buckle rested against the cloth. Only my shoes kept tapping the path.
Say goodbye as he wheels the bicycle away
Listen to the footsteps after the clicks

lead.zh-Hans: 小狗停下来时，我们也都停了一会儿。
lead.en: The dog’s pause became ours too.

text.zh-Hans: 拉普拉塔河还在滨水大道旁铺开，我回到蒙得维的亚，走到半途被一只牵着绳的小狗留住了。它坐下来望着水，主人喊它的名字，它只动了一下耳朵。我也停下看了一会儿，正准备继续走，小狗却忽然站起来，抢先走到了前面。它的主人跟上去，我再出发，自己的影子刚好落在那段空出来的路上。
text.en: The Río de la Plata opened beside the Rambla on my return to Montevideo. Partway along, a dog on a lead sat down to look at the water. Its owner called its name; only one ear moved. I stopped to look too. Just as I prepared to leave, the dog stood and set off ahead of us. Its owner followed. When I began walking again, my shadow fell across the stretch they had just cleared.
Say goodbye to the dog that paused
Look at the newly empty path
